Solution B is correct. The count is 26 × 25 × 10 × 9 = 58,500: 26 × 25 = 650, 650 × 10 = 6,500, and 6,500 × 9 = 58,500.

Solution A sets up the same product but then "cancels a factor of 5" as if there were a denominator. There isn't one, so the simplification is invalid. Its final value of 5,850 is off by a factor of 10 from the true product.

WINNER: B
